title: Asheville viewer's videos of pulsating lights

tellings.quote: I have seven videos of them from last night. Around 30 minutes of good video. I'm in Asheville, North Carolina.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels reads out a message from a viewer in Asheville, North Carolina, in 2024. The viewer says they filmed pulsating lights in the sky the night before and have seven videos, about 30 minutes of good footage. Michels raises it as fresh evidence while challenging a UFO skeptic in a debate.
